answer: Peers verify the burn against a shared mirror ledger, and any identity lacking a valid ember-stamped receipt is ignored. Each agent must burn a scarce, non-transferable proof-of-work token whose cost scales with claimed reputation, forcing sybils to pay real compute per identity. To deter recycling, burnt tokens decay to umber after one epoch, so maintaining many puppets demands continuous spend while honest single agents pay once. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
